decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management is extremely close to the firm's core expertise and a strategic flagship, giving high absorptive capacity to learn and improve.
Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on existing crew and travel operations, so the firm can readily assimilate results and adapt.
The online vessel information portal is a strategic focus that extends existing vessel knowledge, and cooperation with research institutions can supply any missing digital capabilities.

The mobile vessel performance app uses vessel performance data close to the firm's service knowledge, though its software element raises some uncertainty, it remains manageable through learning and partnerships.
